general.meritName: ASU Commitment Scholarship — $5,500-$7,500/yr range (replaces WUE for Fall 2026+ admits); low end used, his-cycle amount not yet published
general.note: Barrett is the play here — arguably the strongest honors college in the country layered on huge research capacity. Mayo Clinic partnership (MedStart, shadowing pipelines) is a real premed asset. COST CAVEAT: ASU is ENDING WUE for students admitted Fall 2026 onward — the WUE 150%-of-resident rate is simply not available to him. The replacement is the ASU Commitment Scholarship, published as a RANGE of $5,500-$7,500/yr, not a flat award; this list uses the $5,500 low end. Full 2026-27 Tempe non-resident cost of attendance is $63,394/yr ($39,262 tuition+fees + $18,819 housing/food + $5,313 books/personal). ASU has published NO 2027-28 rates and NO scholarship terms for his actual application cycle as of 2026-09-05 — those are unknown, not projected here.
general.medNote: At ASU scale you must self-advocate, but Barrett shrinks it. Auto merit by stats.
